changeSet.author: Arun
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE event ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(200), description VARCHAR(500), start_date_time TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, end_date_time TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, location VARCHAR(500), tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL, organized_by BIGINT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, registration_required BOOLEAN, max_participants BIGINT, created_by BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_by BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenant (id), FOREIGN KEY (organized_by) REFERENCES users (id) );

changeSet.author: Arun
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE event_participants ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, event_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_by BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_by BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id), FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES event (id) );
